what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: maximised logLik of the pois_na_drop fit
cases.note: Poisson, K = 1, p = 6, n = 150 (sha256 checked); R: value ~ 0 + trait + latent(0 + trait | unit, d = 1, unique = FALSE), family = poisson(), converged with a positive-definite Hessian; same optimum (logLik within 1e-6, asserted in the test). The sign of a one-axis loading is not identified, so loadings are compared through Lambda Lambda'. 12 response cells are NA (column value_na). R: default miss_control() (response = drop: the cell is dropped, the unit keeps its other traits); Julia: the same matrix with 12 `missing` entries.
